title: Cryptocurrency Explained: Money as a System-of-Control
summary: Andreas Antonopoulos argues that money has a fourth function beyond store of value, medium of exchange and unit of account, which is as a system of control. He covers the history of money and why it does not flow freely.
why: Cited in discussions of cryptocurrency, KYC/AML and financial surveillance as a framing of money as a tool of control.

quote.text: Andreas Antonopoulos is a good person to listen to on this topic.
